title: List retained classification outcomes
description: Publish classify.outcome.list as a bounded snapshot-bound query over one retained evaluation so an owner or Hermes agent can discover selectable outcomes without one process per transaction. Implements G7 and UC-CLASSIFY-007.
rationale: The shipped single-outcome query is correct but cannot enumerate a batch within the motivating orchestration timeout.
story_want: page and filter all outcomes from one evaluation
story_so_that: I can select a batch and request deeper explanation only where needed
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed retained evaluation ID and pageSize from 1 through 500, when classify.outcome.list is invoked without a continuation, then it returns the first filtered page ordered by ordinal then transaction ID, overall and filtered totals, returned count, evaluation and result fingerprints, and an opaque continuation when rows remain.

Given bounded filters for outcome kind, suggested category ID, contributing rule-version ID, stale state, or transaction ID, when outcome.list succeeds, then every returned item satisfies every supplied filter and the filter fingerprint is bound into the continuation.

Given a returned item, when it is inspected, then it contains outcome ID, transaction ID, ordinal, kind, a stable reason code or bounded reason text, suggested category ID and display name when applicable, contributing rule-version IDs, matched field keys, conflict summary, stale dimensions, and the permitted next operation without a source description, amount, normalized value, corpus path, or raw rule payload.

Given an opaque continuation, when the same evaluation, filters, page size, Evaluation Fingerprint, category lifecycle fingerprint, rule-set fingerprint, and Ledger generation remain current, then the next call resumes after the last ordinal and transaction ID with no duplicate or omitted row.

Given a malformed, expired, cross-evaluation, cross-filter, cross-page-size, or fingerprint-mismatched continuation, when outcome.list is invoked, then it returns a typed CLASSIFY cursor or stale error with a null result and no partial page.

Given a missing, abandoned, incomplete, or expired evaluation; a missing active rule set; an archived suggested category; a stale Ledger generation; incompatible classification_v1 projection; or impossible row accounting, when outcome.list is invoked, then it fails closed with the typed lifecycle, not-found, stale, compatibility, or integrity error and performs no CLASSIFY or Ledger mutation.

Given the motivating completed evaluation with 146 outcomes and pageSize 500, when an owner-local published executable invokes outcome.list, then all 146 selectable rows are returned by one initial CLI process and no per-outcome process is required.
security_criteria: The query never returns or logs source descriptions, normalized values, amounts, private paths, serialized requests, or caller-supplied authority claims; cursors contain only versioned bounded metadata and fingerprints.
